text:
javier: Quick heads-up — we're going to canary q8b-quant-v2 on the eval pool tonight. Need a short curation + deid pass on the anchor prompts before we push.

anika: ETA on the canary? I can run a dedupe against the seedbank and flag overlays. want me to focus on synthetic anchors vs organic? :mag:

mike: Can we also scope a tiny golden smoke set (50 examples) to catch hallucination/regression patterns? last time q4b flipped some QA outputs.

sophia: good call. i'll own the golden smoke. will prioritize safety-sensitive intents + terse conversion prompts. sending schema for labels in 10m.

javier: start time planned 22:00 UTC. canary will route 5% of traffic for 2h. if dedupe+deid pass isn't done we fallback.

anika: doing dedupe now — run plan: 1) fingerprint match on normalized prompt 2) embed-sim threshold 0.92 for near-duplicates 3) mark synthetic-anchor if source contains "synthgen" tag. i'll produce CSV with flags.

mike: for the golden smoke, include these tags: "hallucination", "slot-bleed", "broken-format", "safety". please add expected severity (low/med/high).

sophia: label schema -> single JSONL col: id, prompt, expected_response, severity, notes. quick examples attached in #docs-promptset (link)

labeler-bot: New task bundle created: curation-q8b-2026-03-20 (120 items). Reviewers: @elaine, @anika. Deadline 2026-03-21 08:00 UTC.

elaine: i'll do the deid pass. reminder — redact emails/phone/personal names and replace with placeholders (<EMAIL>, <PHONE>, <NAME>). keep context length. will not remove anchors that are semantic.

anika: CSV done — 120 rows. 18 exact dups, 22 near-duplicates, 12 flagged synthetic anchors. uploading to /shared/curation/q8b-canary/ (link)

javier: mike/sophia — can you triage the 12 synthetic anchors? we need to know if they are useful testcases or should be removed from canary traffic.

mike: triage started. initial pass: 7 are valid stress tests (long-context paraphrase), 5 are low-quality synths -> recommend exclude.

sophia: golden smoke ready (50 items) — added expected labels. one regression check: q4b had a format regression on multiline lists, included 6 examples for that.

javier: thanks. plan: exclude the 5 low-quality synths, include 7 stress synths in eval only (not production traffic), wire golden smoke to canary monitoring. if error rate > 8% on severity high -> abort and rollback to q8b-quant-v1.

elaine: deid done and verified. left notes on 4 ambiguous names where context needed.

anika: re-ran dedupe after deid — final pool: 95 items for canary, 7 synth stress in eval-only. pushed CSV to path above.

mike: kick off canary now?

javier: starting canary in 10. tagging ops for tracing. :rocket:

labeler-bot: Canary started: q8b-quant-v2 -> 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks: latency, token-cost, golden-smoke-failures.

sophia: early signal: one high-severity hallucination at 22:07 UTC — logged to tracing and golden-smoke. saving convo exported to /incidents/tmp.

mike: saw that trace — looks like prompt truncation + quant artifact. grabbing model logits for that request.

javier: good catch. if we see >2 high-sev in first 30m we abort. keep notes in this thread.

elaine: FYI — QA on deid examples: 0 PII leaks.

anika: dedupe note for postmortem: our embed sim threshold might be too high for long paraphrases; we should include fuzzy-token overlap check next run.

mike: extracting a small repro and opening a bug with runtime team: quant-ctx-truncation. assign to @eng-runtime.

javier: update 23:00 UTC — after 45m: 1 high-sev, 3 med, latency within SLO. continuing for full 2h. thanks team. :thanks:
